# Iron Prairie Fabrication Group LLC

> Certified woman-owned custom metal fabrication shop in Bay City, Texas (200 County Rd 170). Specializing in custom metal fabrication, structural steel, high-definition CNC plasma plate cutting, custom ranch entrance gates, agriculture and livestock equipment, ASME B16.48 paddle blinds, custom tornado shelters & underground bunkers, and custom part fabrication with local Texas hot-shot delivery and daily nationwide shipping across all 50 states.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Custom Metal Fabrication & Structural Steel](https://ironprairiefabrication.com/services): Core capability #1. Comprehensive custom metal fabrication including architectural ranch entrance gates, boundary steel, structural steel welding, equipment skids, pipe fabrication, and custom part manufacturing for ranches, commercial projects, and industrial plants.
- [Ranch Gates & Agriculture Steel](https://ironprairiefabrication.com/services): Heavy-duty architectural entrance gates, fence line pipe, cattle guards, livestock handling pens, corral systems, squeeze chutes, and modular feral hog traps.
- [High-Definition CNC Plasma Plate Cutting](https://ironprairiefabrication.com/services): Precision plasma plate cutting for carbon steel (SA-36, SA-516-70), stainless steel (304L, 316L), and aluminum plate. Precision gussets, baseplates, custom brackets, and production part runs.
- [ASME B16.48 Paddle Blinds & Spacers](https://ironprairiefabrication.com/paddle-blinds): In-house manufactured positive isolation paddle blinds and spacer rings (150# to 2500#, 1/2" to 24"+ NPS) with certified EN 10204 3.1 MTR paperwork, Texas hot-shot turnaround, and daily nationwide shipping.
- [Custom Tornado Shelters & Underground Bunkers](https://ironprairiefabrication.com/services): Engineered protective steel storm shelters, underground survival bunkers, and large built-in heavy security safes.
- [Public Agency & Municipal Metalwork](https://ironprairiefabrication.com/woman-owned): SAM.gov registered (UEI XX7XCMGN9XD5) fabricator for Texas Parks & Wildlife (TPWD), municipalities, counties, and federal procurement.
- [B2B Storefront & Online Configurator](https://ironprairiefabrication.com/storefront): Instant ASME paddle blind configurator with dimensional pricing, weight calculations, MTR documentation, and secure checkout.
